title: Bee Removal in Castle Hill, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Castle Hill, Bronx. Licensed technicians treat and remove nests from walls, eaves, attics. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Castle Hill residents facing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, or carpenter bee nests need prompt, professional treatment to protect their families and properties. Our licensed technicians provide complete nest removal services throughout this vibrant Bronx neighborhood — locating entry points, treating nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, and ground burrows, removing accessible nest material, and sealing openings to prevent recolonization. We understand the unique challenges Castle Hill homeowners face and deliver fast, effective solutions.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over 15 years of specialized bee removal experience to Castle Hill, with licensed technicians who prioritize safety and eco-friendly practices. Our transparent pricing of $350-$550 includes thorough inspection, complete hive removal, and preventative measures to keep bees from returning to your property.
localContext: From the residential homes near Castle Hill Avenue to the apartment complexes along Westchester Avenue, Castle Hill's diverse housing stock provides ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in chimneys, eaves, wall voids, and soffits. The neighborhood's mix of single-family homes and multi-unit buildings near landmarks like Castle Hill Park and Parkchester sees seasonal pressure from ground-nesting yellow jackets and paper wasp colonies that build inside structural gaps. Our team is familiar with the construction styles common here and provides tailored solutions for each property type.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Castle Hill?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Castle Hill property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for most Castle Hill locations. Our team arrives fully equipped to locate the nest, treat it through the entry point, remove accessible material, and seal openings. Most residential jobs are completed within 2–4 hours depending on nest location and access.
